disk._NOTE: files is an array of strings, where the string is the filename + extension

rss._NOTE: feeds is an array of objects where the key is presentational, and the value is the rss URL. i_feeds is a list of internal feeds, powered by a public RSSHub instance. Note that RSSHub is relatively slow. Key is the presentational string, value is the RSSHub endpoint + route

stock._NOTE: This feature only supports up to 10 stock symbols right now, sorry. But symbols is an array of strings that are stock symbols - it is a WIP

displays._NOTE: stream_format is used to govern the order of how data is streamed. Below, you get 1 rss feed, followed by 2 stocks, then it repeats.
